title: INVOL (REACC) ? VOL (Pre-Move, +ve Later) � Positive VOL Deducted from Delay
goal: System auto-rebooked via REACC (INVOL), then customer voluntarily changed to an even LATER flight via Pre-Move (+ve VOL). The extra 2 hours the customer added by going later is DEDUCTED from the total delay. Validates positive VOL deduction logic after INVOL.

checkpoints.step: System auto-rebooked via REACC (INVOL), then customer voluntarily changed to an even LATER flight via Pre-Move (+ve VOL). The extra 2 hours the customer added by going later is DEDUCTED from the total delay. Validates positive VOL deduction logic after INVOL.

checkpoints.step: And DDS checks booking change history:
checkpoints.expected: ? Change 1 (D-3): REACC auto-rebook (identifier: MUC1A06AC) ? Classification: INVOL (REACC = system-initiated auto-accommodation) ? REACC changed arrival from 10:00 ? 14:00 ? Promise update: NO � INVOL does NOT update promise ? Promise remains at: 10:00 (14-day mark � no VOL before this INVOL) ? Change 2 (D-2): Pre-Move tool (identifier: RF-PMV / YMQAC0848) ? Classification: VOL (Pre-Move is always voluntary) ? Pre-Move changed arrival from 14:00 ? 16:00 (customer went LATER by +2hrs) ? Direction: POSITIVE (+2hrs � customer chose a later flight than the REACC result) ? Promise update: VOL after INVOL does NOT update promise (promise already locked at 14-day mark since no VOL preceded the INVOL) ? Promise remains at: 10:00

checkpoints.step: ? Total delay = 16:00 - 10:00 = 6 hours (actual - promise)
checkpoints.expected: ? Post-INVOL VOL direction = POSITIVE (+2hrs � customer went LATER) ? Positive VOL = DEDUCTED from total delay ? Deduction amount = +2hrs (16:00 - 14:00 = time added by customer's VOL choice) ? Net delay = 6hrs - 2hrs = 4 hours ? APPR: Net delay 3�6h, Controllable (Code 42) ? ELIGIBLE � $400 CAD (Tier 1) ? CRITICAL ASSERTION: Positive VOL after INVOL must be deducted. The customer voluntarily chose a later flight � the extra 2 hours are the customer's responsibility, not the airline's. Net delay (4hrs) is used for tier calculation, NOT total delay (6hrs).
